title: SmartBroom 2026.9
body:
# A Whole New SmartBroom App

Welcome to v2026.9, we're delighted you could join us! For this year the app is fully rebuilt from the ground up with a huge number of exciting enhancements.

### All New for SmartBroom 4
- Background sweep data capture
- Database for sweep data synced through iCloud
- Sweeper database with sweep history
- 'Me' sweeper
- All new raw live data mode
- Sweep sessions and intervals
- Stroke-by-stroke measurement and display 
- Plow stroke support

## Improvements For Older SmartBrooms
- SmartBroom 2 or 3 .csv sweep files can be imported into the synced database and assigned to sweepers
